# TeslaUSB Enhanced v2.0.0

Version 2.0 adds a modern, responsive interface for Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W,
while preserving the Classic UI and the existing recording and archive tools.
The new version, image filenames, and embedded source metadata use `2.0.0`.
Previously published release tags and checksums remain unchanged.

TeslaUSB Enhanced is an independent project, not endorsed by or affiliated
with Tesla, Raspberry Pi, or the upstream TeslaUSB maintainers.

## Modern recording library and viewer

- Start with the newest available recording day. Browse daily footage by hour,
  with pagination, search, and separate recording, snapshot, and refresh times.
- Recording cards show a lightweight first available front-camera keyframe
  when supported. Stills load on demand and have a clear fallback when a frame
  cannot be prepared. They do not download six full videos for each card.
- Existing browser sessions receive the updated scripts and styles together
  after a normal reload, with revalidation on future visits.
- Single-camera original-quality playback is the default. **Load clip first**
  prepares the selected minute before playback, with byte progress,
  cancellation, and clear errors. Loaded copies are released when leaving or
  changing the selection. The limits are 64 MiB per camera and 256 MiB total.
- Six-camera overview uses small stills. Select a camera to play its original,
  or choose synchronized **All cameras** video when the connection and browser
  can handle it. Six original streams can still buffer over slow Wi-Fi.
- The modern viewer no longer offers on-device Low video conversion or leaves
  users waiting for a smaller preview. Lightweight JPEG stills remain available.
- Previous/next clip, optional autoplay (off by default), minus/plus 10 seconds,
  playback speed, fullscreen, and Sentry-event navigation make review easier.
- Footage comes from completed snapshots; the overview is not a live camera
  feed. Missing cameras and encrypted recordings remain clearly identified.

## Storage, downloads, and device tools

- Sentry and Saved recordings can move to **Trash**, with restoration,
  30-day retention, and a separate permanent-delete action. Restored copies
  still occupy storage, which is shown separately from Trash usage.
- Download one camera or all available cameras, with preparation feedback,
  cancellation, and failure/retry messages.
- Archive status includes pending transfers, progress, last success, and
  **Sync now**. Optional Music, LightShow, and Boombox drives retain file tools.
- Device tools include the network test, USB controls and repair, restart,
  shutdown, and SSH help. Disruptive actions require an explicit confirmation.
  BLE pairing is not included in the modern interface.
- Diagnostics are separated into sections with full-log viewing, search,
  wrapping, refresh, and downloadable logs. Connection-loss reporting is
  separate from the car's USB connection status.
- Existing filesystem, encrypted-recording, least-privilege, and read-only
  runtime safeguards remain in place. Updating the UI does not require
  interrupting recording.
- Correct the web log directory's mount permissions so nginx can validate and
  reload its configuration with the operating system's file protections enabled.

## Image and installation

The image targets **Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W**, using 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS Lite
(Debian Trixie). Use a high-endurance microSD card of at least 64 GB. Connect
the vehicle to the Pi's USB data/OTG port.

Download the matching `.img.xz`, `.img.xz.sha256`, `.image-metadata.json`, and
`.packages.tsv` assets. Verify the compressed image's SHA-256 before flashing.
Select **Use custom** in Raspberry Pi Imager and do not apply Imager OS
customization; use the included offline configuration wizard after flashing.
Back up configuration, keys, and recordings before replacing an existing card.

A GitHub release does not automatically update an already installed card.
Do not substitute an older image with a renamed file: this build has its own
source commit, embedded version, package record, and image checksums.

## Verification

Automated validation passed for the published image, including runtime and
browser regressions, source and image manifests, boot configuration,
locked-account and credential-absence checks, compressed-image integrity,
and uploaded-asset digest matching.
[Successful image build](https://github.com/jakubgt/teslausb-enhanced/actions/runs/34313848436).

- Image source: [`0faa237524f61053023de7172d6bbf69855d4fa6`](https://github.com/jakubgt/teslausb-enhanced/commit/0faa237524f61053023de7172d6bbf69855d4fa6).
- Compressed image SHA-256: `8ffe7c02764bed3bb0cc4a50a79ce135d454c187279c4742550538b1270ca4e4`.

Selected modern UI behavior has been tested on an existing Zero 2 W,
including six-camera stills and fully buffered original playback. Fresh-card
hardware acceptance for this image has not been independently confirmed.

The original verified build is published without replacing its assets or
moving its source tag. A rebuilt image requires its own verification.
